vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Ingrid was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Mia taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Ingrid was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Rosa taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Duc has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Rosa is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.
Rosa showed Giulia the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Mia drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🛡️ Ingrid, Mia, Rosa and Giulia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ingrid, Mia, Rosa, Giulia are hurt.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Tayfun, Ingrid, Giulia and Ruby met them at the door — 4 put down. Ingrid, Ruby are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kojo and Benito met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Kojo, Benito are hurt.
